experiment: TUM fr1_room frozen DA2 Small known-pose RGB global depth-scale replay

visual_conclusion: Screen and desk recognizable from heldout views but geometry remains swollen and warped. Free views still broken. Changes are minor; one heldout coverage decreases and largest connected fraction falls. No room-structure acceptance.
evidence_limits: Correspondence holdout is pixels of the same training scene, not independent physical truth. 3+2 render is actual Mesh; original RGB not used in candidate. No browser integration claim.
next: Replace per-frame DA2 metric fit with mature dense multi-view depth/pose-aware global surface estimation; test same frozen 3+2 scene before proceeding to estimated poses.
